mechanism: Both agents can cause photosensitivity and doxycycline may impair ethambutol's absorption through chelation or gastrointestinal effects; ethambutol can cause optic neuritis which may be masked by concurrent doxycycline use.
action: Monitor for photosensitivity reactions, ensure adequate sun protection, separate dosing times if possible, and perform baseline and periodic ophthalmologic examinations to detect ethambutol-induced optic neuritis.
